summary.text: Michael Hastings is a member of the Illinois Senate, first elected in 2012.
His official biography lists Hastings as chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hastings graduated from the United States Military Academy at West Point and served as a U.S. Army officer during Operation Iraqi Freedom, where he earned the Bronze Star.
He earned an MBA with honors from the University of Illinois and a Juris Doctor from the University of Illinois at Chicago John Marshall Law School, and he practices law in the southwest suburbs.
Hastings was elected to the Illinois State Senate in 2012, and the biography describes him as one of the youngest senators in state history.

The biography says his work has focused on mental health services, educational opportunities, public safety, natural resources and local businesses, and that his legislation on cyberbullying was published in the Council of State Governments magazine.
